## 2025 - 2026 Tuition

University of Massachusetts Global reserves the right to change any of the following tuition and fee rates without notice.

### Online Programs

--- | --- | --- | ---
Associate Degree  | $500  | 3  | $1,500
Bachelor's Degree  | $500  | 3  | $1,500
Credential  | $770  | 3  | $2,310
Master's Degree  | $770  | 3  | $2,310
Doctorate of Education  | $1,140  | 3  | $3,420
Doctorate of Social Work  | $1,140  | 3  | $3,420

### Active-Duty Military and Spouses

Degree  | Cost Per Credit Unit  | Typical # of Units Per Course  | Typical Cost Per Course
--- | --- | --- | ---
Associate Degree  | $250  | 3  | $750
Bachelor's Degree  | $250  | 3  | $750
Credential  | $430  | 3  | $1,290
Master's Degree  | $430  | 3  | $1,290
Doctorate of Education  | $1,140  | 3  | $3,420
Doctorate of Social Work  | $1,140  | 3  | $3,420

  1. If you are using Tuition Assistance (TA) to pay for your education and drop or withdraw from a course prior to completing 60 percent of the course, the Department of Defense requires that the university return any unearned TA funds to the department based on how much of the course you completed and that you pay a portion of those returned funds. You may owe a portion of your tuition to the university and a portion to your military branch. Before dropping or withdrawing from a course, please contact your military education counselor or education services officer to determine how it could impact your Military Tuition Assistance and potential repayment obligations.
  2. Active-Duty Military students dropping within the first two weeks of classes or withdrawing after the second week through 60% of the course are subject to the refunding schedule above. However, if a student dropped due to a military service obligation, they may be eligible to file a petition for an exception to the refunding policy. Please see your Academic Advisor or One-Stop Specialist for assistance with the petition process.

## Cost of Attendance

### Cost of Attendance for the Year 2025 – 2026

"Cost of attendance" is the estimated average and reasonable cost of completing an academic year at University of Massachusetts Global. The cost of attendance is also sometimes referred to as your student budget. Your cost of attendance can be found in self-service after you have been awarded assistance. Because estimates are based on federal criteria for a single student without dependents, your actual expenses may vary.

2025–2026
Expense Category  | Off-Campus Housing
--- | ---
Tuition  | See Actual Institutional Charges
Fees  | Varies — Please refer to the catalog for a full listing of fees. (opens in a new window)^{2}
Books & Supplies  | $1,089 per academic year^{1}
Food  | $837 per month
Housing  | $1,691 per month^{2}
Transportation  | $221 per month^{1}
Personal  | $563 per month
Loan Fees  | Varies based on amount of federal loans borrowed.^{3}

NOTE: The expense budgets shown in this table are based upon average expenses reported by students at the University of California, California State University, California independent institutions, and California Community Colleges in the 2021-22 Student Expenses and Resources Survey (SEARS). It is adjusted for inflation using the 2025-26 CCPI, CSAC 2025-2026 Expense Budget.
